description: Describes the Penguin Statistics drop data: what its numbers mean (times, quantity, drop rate, sanity per item, window), the game servers with their time zones and how fresh the data of each is, the caveats, the license and how to credit it. Call it when unsure how to read or cite the numbers.
name: get_dataset_info

docs.description: Documentation of the public API of Penguin Statistics

openapi.description: OpenAPI (Swagger 2.0) document of the public API

dataAsOf.description: When the drop counts of the server were last calculated, RFC 3339 in UTC; not how recent its stages and events are (see latestEventOpenTime)

latestEventOpenTime.description: Open time of the newest event Penguin Statistics lists for the server, RFC 3339 in UTC: a newer event running in the game may be missing from its catalog

matrixAvailable.description: Whether the drop data of the server is loaded

timezone.description: Time zone of the days of the server, e.g. UTC+8

attribution.description: The credit to give wherever this data is used

url.description: The page of this data on Penguin Statistics, or its home page

title: Dataset info
